incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark, turbulent cloud formation dominates the sky above a line of trees and some buildings, with smoke or ash plumes rising from the ground on the right.

observations.description: Large plumes of dark and light-colored smoke or ash rising from the ground on the right side of the image.
A dense line of dark trees and some scattered trees in the foreground and midground.
A few buildings, including what appears to be a house with a porch, visible on the right side of the image.
Large, ominous cloud formation covering most of the sky, suggesting a severe weather system or fire-related event.
